experiments.description: Aircraft load optimization for Airbus challenge problem 5, formulated as a knapsack-style optimization and solved with a VQE approach on IBM online quantum computers.

experiments.description: Aircraft load optimization implemented on quantum annealing machines using a QUBO formulation.

algorithm.variant: QUBO formulation for cargo loading / aircraft load optimization

problem_formulation.objective_function: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization objective for cargo loading; specific matrix Q and full objective not provided.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Handled within the QUBO formulation; explicit penalty terms not reported.
